title: Preparing to cross — reliance before performance
shortTitle: Preparing to cross — reliance before performance
summary: The notes vary the bridge example so that the offeree has spent time and money but has not yet begun the requested crossing.
notes: Would § 45 apply? What additional inquiry does § 87(2) require? Explain why expenditures can matter to reliance without automatically being the performance requested in the offer.
